content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NPCC Consultant Liaison Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Consultant Liaison Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Projects Construction Corporation (NPCC), a prominent PSU organization offering contractual career opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NPCC?
faq.answer: NPCC has advertised for the post of Consultant-Liaison under advertisement number 500518/Consultant/2026 on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant-Liaison post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant-Liaison position in this recruitment drive by NPCC Limited.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Consultant-Liaison?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Consultant-Liaison post must possess a Bachelor's degree in any discipline along with relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required experience for NPCC Consultant-Liaison?
faq.answer: Applicants must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in Liaison, Coordination, or Public Relations (PR) works to be eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 60 years as per the guidelines laid out in the official NPCC notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Consultant-Liaison post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Consultant-Liaison position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 70,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of selection for NPCC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a Walk-In-Interview followed by document verification of the shortlisted eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 09-10-2026 with candidate entry permitted from 9:00 AM to 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q10. What is the venue address for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at NPCC Limited, Plot No.148, Sector-44, Gurugram, Haryana, with all original and photocopied documents.
